key.name: update-interval
key.description: Number of seconds between two refreshes of the displayed values.

key.name: show-cpu
key.description: Whether the CPU reading is shown in the top bar and the menu.

key.name: show-ram
key.description: Whether the RAM reading is shown in the top bar and the menu.

key.name: show-disk
key.description: Whether the disk reading is shown in the top bar and the menu.

key.name: disk-path
key.description: Path of the filesystem whose usage is displayed (for example "/" or "/home").
